title: Activity islands
brief: Find activity islands using a declared maximum gap.
instructions: Use all orders in every status and year. Deduplicate customer/UTC dates. Consecutive active dates at most three days apart belong to one island. Return its endpoints and distinct active-day count.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_id,customer_id,ordered_at from orders without solving activity islands.

hints.text: Detect gaps with LAG and use a running group marker.
Deduplicate dates first; mark gaps above three days, then aggregate each cumulative group.
Two June orders share a day and count as one active day.
